hits.title: Screams, Body On Road: Moment After Aston Martin Runs Over Hyderabad Woman
hits.snippet: Stop, stop, a man is desperately heard saying while knocking on the bright red Aston Martin that had just knocked down and killed a 26-year-old woman who had stepped out for lunch in Hyderabad, shows a video. A short distance away, the woman is lying flat on the road in a pool of blood. A woman, next to her, is screaming wildly in pain at the sight, the disturbing video shows.
